verdict.rationale: Teams offers Export APIs to extract chat, channel, and meeting messages (ms-teams-docs-13, ms-teams-docs-14) and the underlying Graph API exposes data via a machine-readable OData schema (ms-teams-probe-5), but these are enterprise compliance/eDiscovery exports gated by admin permissions and OAuth (ms-teams-probe-6), not a self-service open-format personal data export/account-deletion flow for an individual AI-native user. missing for 10: self-service personal data export tool for end users, documentation of open/portable data formats (not just proprietary Graph schema), explicit account deletion/'leave with your data' workflow, independent confirmation of export completeness or fidelity.
